rules.value: rule STAI_Example_Marker_Text { meta: author = "STAI" description = "Harmless demonstration marker; not malware intelligence" strings: $marker = "STAI_EXAMPLE_TEXT_MARKER_V1" condition: filesize < 4096 and $marker }

rule STAI_Example_Marker_Pair { meta: author = "STAI" description = "Harmless two-marker demonstration; not malware intelligence" strings: $a = "STAI_EXAMPLE_PAIR_ALPHA_V1" $b = "STAI_EXAMPLE_PAIR_BETA_V1" condition: filesize < 4096 and all of them }

rule STAI_Example_Marker_Header { meta: author = "STAI" description = "Harmless offset-constrained demonstration; not malware intelligence" strings: $header = "STAI_EXAMPLE_HEADER_V1" condition: filesize < 4096 and $header at 0 }
